title: Two new models for decisions and text
summary:
New decision and text models, sandboxes that wake on demand, and a hosted visual agent arrived alongside model compatibility fixes.

Community contributions added paid-only `heygen/heygen-decision-1` for typed Yes/No, Choice, and Score decisions through `/alpha/decisions` and chat completions. They also added paid-only `thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini` for text and image input, with tool calling, JSON responses, reasoning parameters, and a 1,048,576-token context window.

Team work added opt-in Auto mode to sandbox controls, with Azure idle suspension and resumption. Shared Azure ports can also accept signed Discord interactions: verification pings do not wake a sandbox, while slash commands are acknowledged before it wakes. The sandbox and Discord port behavior was documented.

Opposite Prompt was added as a hosted agent that turns text or an attached image into a visual opposite, with image, video, GIF, and vector options. The CatGPT configuration was aligned with its official agent listing. Creator Studio for TikTok joined the community app catalog.

daily.title: HeyGen Decision 1
daily.text: Use paid-only `heygen/heygen-decision-1` to get typed Yes/No, Choice, or Score decisions from text, image, audio, or video input through `/alpha/decisions` or chat completions. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=heygen/heygen-decision-1).

daily.title: Inkling 2 Mini
daily.text: Use paid-only `thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini` with text or image input, tools, JSON responses, reasoning parameters, and a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini).

daily.title: Auto mode for sandboxes
daily.text: Choose opt-in Auto mode to let an Azure sandbox suspend when idle and resume on a request to a shared port. Leases are prepaid, and the UI has a 10-minute minimum duration. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Opposite Prompt agent
daily.text: Give Opposite Prompt text or an image and ask for a visual opposite. It can make an image, video, GIF, or vector graphic.

daily.title: Discord commands for sandbox ports
daily.text: Share an Azure sandbox port with a Discord application's `discordPublicKey` to accept signed interactions. Verification pings leave the sandbox asleep; slash commands are acknowledged before it wakes and receives the request. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
